LanguageData.GR_GoauldDomainUltimatum_Text:
A transmission from {0} condemns the extraction of the Goa'uld {1} from {2}.
The domain demands that the extracted symbiote be surrendered within one day. Compliance will avert an attack. Refusal or silence will bring a Jaffa reprisal whose strength reflects the colony's threat level when the extraction was completed.
LanguageData.GR_GoauldDomainUltimatum_NoLongerActive: This ultimatum is no longer active.
LanguageData.GR_GoauldDomainUltimatum_SymbioteUnavail: {0} is no longer available on the colony map.
LanguageData.GR_GoauldDomainUltimatum_Surrendered: {0} has been surrendered to {1}. The domain calls off its reprisal.
LanguageData.GR_GoauldDomainReprisal_DefiedText:
{0} acknowledges the colony's defiance over the extracted Goa'uld {1} from {2}.
Jaffa forces are mobilizing against the colony. Their arrival is expected in {3}.
LanguageData.GR_GoauldDomainReprisal_ExpiredText:
{0} received no answer to its demand for the extracted Goa'uld {1} from {2}.
Jaffa forces are mobilizing against the colony. Their arrival is expected in {3}.
LanguageData.GR_GoauldDomainReprisal_SymbioteDestroye:
{0} learned that the extracted Goa'uld {1} from {2} was killed while its surrender was demanded.
The killing is treated as open defiance. Jaffa forces are expected in {3}.
LanguageData.GR_GoauldDomainFatalExtraction_Text:
{0} learned that the attempted extraction of the Goa'uld {1} from {2} ended in death.
There is no symbiote left to surrender. Jaffa forces are expected in {3}.
LanguageData.GR_GoauldDomainReprisal_AttackFailed: The announced Goa'uld reprisal could not reach the colony.
LanguageData.GR_GoauldSharedAllianceReprisal_WarningT: Following the decisive defeat of a raid from {0}, that domain has called on its ally {1}. A coordinated reprisal against the colony is expected in {2}.
LanguageData.GR_GoauldSharedAllianceReprisal_ArrivalT: The forces of {0} are carrying out their reprisal with support from {1}. Two Jaffa detachments bearing the colors of the two domains are advancing from opposite sides of the colony.
LanguageData.GR_GoauldSharedAllianceReprisal_AttackFa: The announced shared Goa'uld reprisal could not reach the colony.
LanguageData.GR_GoauldAllianceRupture_Text0: The failed shared reprisal has triggered mutual accusations between {0} and {1}. Each domain blames the other for the loss. Their alliance is dissolved and replaced by open rivalry.
LanguageData.GR_GoauldAllianceRupture_Text1: Commanders from {0} and {1} have denounced one another after the collapse of their joint reprisal. The alliance has ended; the two domains now regard each other as rivals.
LanguageData.GR_GoauldAllianceRupture_Text2: The survivors of the shared reprisal carried incompatible accounts back to {0} and {1}. Neither domain accepts responsibility. Their alliance is broken and rivalry now governs their relations.
